t.why: The diplomatic and logistics hub of East Africa, it led the security support mission to Haiti.
t.rel: East Africa's economic and diplomatic hub. It has suffered attacks by Somalia's al-Shabaab and led the security support mission to Haiti.
t.know: It produces many of the world's great marathon runners.
t.etext: Tea, flower and coffee exports and tourism are big, and it is East Africa's financial and logistics hub. It is famous as an early adopter of mobile money. Heavy government debt led to conflict over tax increases.
